headline: The AI boom has become a key element in Fed policy
summary: Recent inflation and growth data are described as too high and strong, with growth dependent on AI investment, so the Fed needs any slowdown to stay contained, according to El Economista.
why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, which influence borrowing costs, equity valuations and the dollar worldwide.
original_headline: El auge de la IA se ha convertido en un elemento clave en la política de la Fed
